---
title: Add a SearchSection  
description: Learn how to add a searchable section with filters and results to your LightNet page.
---

The `SearchSection` component lets you add a powerful search interface to your LightNet page. It includes search filters and displays matching results automatically.

![Search section with a text search input, Language, Type, and Category filter dropdowns, and a list of matching media items with cover image, title, author, content language, category, and shortened description](./images/search.webp)

Here’s a basic example of how to use the component:

```astro
---
import { Page, SearchSection } from "lightnet/components"
---
<Page>
  <SearchSection />
</Page>
```

## Reference

The `SearchSection` component extends the functionality of the [Section component](/build/pages/section),
so you can use all the same props to control layout, title, and appearance.
